description: Judge whether a finished simulation converged by the user's own standard. Unset fields keep the standard test: every reported residual (continuity, Ux, Uy, Uz, energy) at or below 1e-3 and none rising over the last 20% of iterations; forces count only when named in forces. Uses the run's full saved history: no compute, no charge, and the saved verdict is unchanged. Report the status, its reasons and the thresholds used. When the user states their standard before a run, pass it as run_simulation's convergence_criteria.

force_band_floor.description: Spread always allowed, for coefficients near zero.

force_band_percent.description: Largest max-min spread of each named force coefficient over the window, as a percentage of its mean.

forces.description: Force coefficients that must also settle, e.g. drag_coefficient, lift_coefficient; default none.

max_energy_balance_error.description: CHT: the thermal solve must converge and the heat balance close within this fraction of the heat input (default 0.01, 1%); null judges only thermal convergence.

max_final_residual.description: Each final residual must be at or below this value (default 1e-3); null drops the limit.

min_residual_orders_dropped.description: Also require each residual to have fallen this many orders of magnitude from its peak.

residual_rise_orders.description: A residual is rising when the window's later half is this many orders of magnitude above its earlier half.

residuals.description: Residuals to judge, e.g. continuity; default every one reported.

window_fraction.description: Share of the iterations run, counted back from the last, that the test examines.

window_iterations.description: Examine this many final iterations instead of window_fraction.

name: assess_convergence
title: Judge convergence
